subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should PluginHookAgentContext permanently expose a deferred resetSession API for successful after_compaction hooks across all embedded and native compaction implementations?
rationale: This is a new plugin capability that can rotate persistent session state; repository policy requires explicit ownership of the permanent API contract, supported emitters, and failure semantics rather than inferring direction from an external plugin's need.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
options.body: Approve after-compaction-only, current-session resets, require consistent lifecycle-owned support across advertised emitters, and repair the remaining ordering defects before merge.

options.title: Keep resets internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and implement any required recovery as an owner-specific internal policy until a broader plugin lifecycle design is approved.

options.title: Support selected emitters only
options.body: Explicitly document and type a smaller supported subset while withholding the API from Copilot, Codex, or other paths without safe lifecycle ownership.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve after-compaction-only, current-session resets, require consistent lifecycle-owned support across advertised emitters, and repair the remaining ordering defects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to the Gateway reset service and session lifecycle semantics that define the proposed contract.
